title: lift your eyes

verses.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.

caption:
Some days you look up before you even know what you are looking for.

Psalm 121 starts with a question and answers it in the very next breath. The help is not in the hills. It is in the One who made them, and His attention on you does not lapse while you sleep or while you travel.

Psalm 121:1, 121:2 and 121:8 (BSB)

Save this for the day you need it. Send it to someone who is carrying a lot right now.
